discovery.method: recursive walk of Category:Quests and its 20 subcategories, plus an allpages prefix sweep of mainspace 'Quest:' titles, plus Template:Infobox Quest transclusions, plus links from the area index pages
discovery.sweep_method: full mainspace sweep: action=query&list=allpages (namespace 0, non-redirects) -> raw wikitext for every page -> classify by STRUCTURE (Objectives/Objective heading, Journal Entry heading, roman/chapter step headings, Reward heading, mmodb quest table), independent of title, category or infobox
discovery.provenance_field: every record carries discovery: 'convention' (original 552) or 'sweep' (found by the structural sweep)

schema.quest_name: infobox |name=, else page title with the 'Quest:' prefix removed
schema.infobox_objectives: ordered objective summary from the infobox |objective= field
schema.steps: ORDERED list of quest steps; see step schema
schema.notes: page-level ==Notes== bullets (populated on sweep-discovered records only)
schema.page_text: whole-page prose, only for pages that yielded no steps
schema.variant_pages: linked Quest: pages (class/race variants) when the page is a hub
schema.redirect_to: resolved redirect target when the requested title redirected
schema.parse_status: steps_found | objectives_only | prose_only | no_steps_section | variant_hub | index_page | empty | redirect | missing
schema.discovery: 'convention' = found by the original title/category/infobox scrape; 'sweep' = found by the full-mainspace structural sweep

step_schema.roman: roman numeral / chapter number from the heading, if any
step_schema.title: step heading text with the numeral stripped
step_schema.objectives: ordered plain-text objective bullets from the step's ==Objective(s)== subsection
step_schema.journal: in-game journal entry text for the step

notes_on_coverage: Steps come from the wiki's per-step page sections (== I. Title == with an ==== Objectives ====/==== Journal Entry ==== pair), not from game data.
31 pages are prose-only (mostly crafting/recipe-grant quests and a few walkthrough stubs) and carry page_text instead of steps.
prerequisite is populated on only 1 page: the wiki almost never fills the infobox |prereqs= field. Chain direction is available forward (next_quest, 149 pages) far more than backward.
level is present on 170 of 552 pages; the infobox |levelreq= field is usually left blank.
Wiki area index pages link many quests that have no page at all (e.g. Quests: Aquilonia lists 313 links of which 73 exist), so this is the wiki's coverage, not the game's full quest set.
Wiki-side duplicates are preserved as separate records (e.g. 'Traveling Home'/'Travelling Home', 'The Pic Threat'/'The Pict Threat'); dedup key is page_title.
No content is inferred: every field is read off the page, and gaps are null rather than guessed.

A second pass swept all 5,793 non-redirect mainspace pages and classified them by wikitext STRUCTURE rather than by title/category/infobox; it added 14 pages the conventions could not see (plain-layout pages with no 'Quest:' prefix, no quest category and no infobox). Every record carries a `discovery` field so the two populations stay separable.

Sweep-discovered pages use plainer layouts: roman step headings (== I. Title == / == I: Title == / ==== Chapter I. ====), a flat ==Objectives==/==Rewards== shape with no steps at all (recorded as parse_status objectives_only, objectives in infobox_objectives), one mmodb-scraped table page, and one page whose roman step labels are body text rather than headings.
The sweep's structural test cannot see a quest page that states no objective, reward or step anywhere - the same blind spot the original scrape had for pages carrying only prose.
content_note: Structure only. The per-step 'journal' narrative and page 'overview' prose were dropped: that text is Funcom's, and the emulator already sources journal text from the client's own records - keeping a second transcription would duplicate it and add a rival source of truth. What is kept is what the wiki uniquely adds: the ORDERED step decomposition, objectives, rewards and chain links.

steps.title: Pushing Back the Dead
notes: At the top of the slope where Raelina has set up animal skull wards, you'll see the ziggurat. It's the small steppe pyramid. There are stairs on the North side.

At the top of the ziggurat is a sigil you can interact with, but not until you find a Spirit's Essence quest item, which drop off Vindictive Spirits and Malignant Spirits. Note: You may only have one Spirit's Essence at a time.

Bring the Spirit's Essence back to the sigil at the top of the ziggurat and use the sigil. This will summon a Tormented Spirit boss. Note: The boss has a knockback attack. When defeated, the Tormented Spirit will drop the Symbol of Life quest item.
Go immediately to the wards on the ground to the south of the ziggurat and find a glowing ward. Interact with it to change to a Symbol of Life / Spiritual Ward.
This should update the objective; complete these steps 4 more times.
